scripts.text:
[Keedz]
I don't allow any living person
to come in this place!
scripts.translation:
[基德兹]
我不允许任何活人
进入这个地方！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's up?

[Gigantia]
Just...
Come over here.
I have something
I must do for you.
scripts.translation:
[吉甘缇娅]
只是……
过来这里。
我有件事
必须为你做。

scripts.text:
[Gigantia]
Your horn is crooked.
Always make sure your horn
is worn straight and neat.
The Lord of Death is always
looking at you.
scripts.translation:
[吉甘缇娅]
你的角歪了。
务必确保你的角
佩戴得端正整齐。
死神一直在注视着你。

scripts.text:
[Gigantia]
The Lord of Death knows
and sees all. It's useless
to hide, and escape from
Death's sweet embrace.
scripts.translation:
[吉甘缇娅]
死神知晓并目睹一切。
试图躲藏，逃避死神甜蜜的拥抱，
是徒劳的。

scripts.text:
[Gigantia]
Hey, wait!
scripts.translation:
[吉甘缇娅]
嘿，等等！

scripts.text:
[Undead Chicken]
I lived a peaceful life as a normal chicken. But then came the day I was tragically killed and eaten by humans. Well... Heh heh~! Now it's my turn! *Cackles*
scripts.translation:
[不死鸡]
我原本作为一只普通的鸡过着平静的生活。但后来有一天，我悲惨地被人类杀死并吃掉了。嗯……嘿嘿~！现在轮到我复仇了！*咯咯笑*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ouch...!
A chicken...
It bit me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好痛……！
一只鸡……
它咬我！

scripts.text:
[Undead Chicken]
Ho ho~!
I can talk AND feast
on living humans!
Being a zombie is great!
*Cackles*
scripts.translation:
[不死鸡]
呵呵~！
我不仅能说话，
还能享用活人！
当僵尸真棒！
*咯咯笑*

scripts.text:
[Vatoman]
Oooh, how handy, a living
human~! Fresh blood is
always tasty...! I think I'll just
take a liiittle sip.
scripts.translation:
[瓦托曼]
噢，真方便，一个活人~！
新鲜的血总是很美味……！
我想我就稍微喝一小口吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ow! My vein!
Did you just
suck my blood?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎哟！我的血管！
你刚才
吸了我的血吗？！

scripts.text:
[Vatoman]
Mwahahaha~
Foolish mortal!
Beware my powers!
scripts.translation:
[瓦托曼]
哇哈哈哈~
愚蠢的凡人！
小心我的力量！

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Where...where am I...?
I remember I was sleeping
and when I woke up, I was here...
Mommy, have you seen my mommy?
I wanna go home...*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
我……我在哪里……？
我记得我在睡觉，
醒来时就在这里了……
妈妈，你见过我妈妈吗？
我想回家……*抽泣*

scripts.text: About the witch
scripts.translation: 关于女巫

scripts.text: About the curse
scripts.translation: 关于诅咒

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Witch...? I've never seen a witch, but I've read about them in books. I'm not sure if they exist or not, but it would be so horrifying if they did...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
女巫……？我从未见过女巫，但我在书里读到过她们。我不确定她们是否真的存在，但如果真的存在，那太可怕了……

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Why is it so cold in here...?
A-aren't you cold, or even scared? I wanna go home... It's warm over there. Could you help me get back... Please...? H-help me...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
为什么这里这么冷……？
你、你不冷吗，甚至不害怕吗？我想回家……那边很暖和。你能帮我回去吗……求求你……？帮、帮帮我……

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
A c-curse...?
My grandma says that there are lots of curses in the world. Some of them, you can tell it's a curse. But there are other curses that follow you throughout life...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
诅、诅咒……？
我奶奶说世界上有很多诅咒。有些诅咒，你能看出来那是诅咒。但还有其他诅咒会伴随你一生……

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Grandma says curses can take other forms... Like if someone's always mad at you, and won't forgive you, you can see that as a curse too.
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
奶奶说诅咒可以采取其他形式……比如如果有人一直生你的气，不肯原谅你，你也可以把那视为一种诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
My grandma told me there's only one spell that can break a strong curse that you can't lift with Blessings...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
奶奶告诉我，只有一种咒语可以打破无法用天使之赐福解除的强大诅咒……

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Klaatu...
Verata.....
Ne...ni...umm...?
What was the last part?
I-I can't remember
the last part of the spell!
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
Klaatu...
Verata.....
Ne...ni...嗯...？
最后一部分是什么？
我、我想不起
咒语的最后一部分了！

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
If you repeat the spell in that order, it will release you from someone's anger and hate. And if you do it near a bad spirit, they might get the curse instead.
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
如果你按那个顺序重复咒语，它将把你从某人的愤怒和仇恨中释放出来。如果你在恶灵附近这样做，他们可能会反而受到诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Why are you asking me about these scary kind of things...? I just wanna go home...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
你为什么问我这些可怕的事情……？我只想回家……

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
It's so cold in here...
I'm freezing...
And I wanna go home and
get away from this scary place...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
这里好冷……
我要冻僵了……
我想回家，
离开这个可怕的地方……

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Please... help me.
Could you take me with you...?
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
求求你……帮帮我。
你能带我一起走吗……？

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I sense you're cursed
by a powerful spell...
Hmm... It's clear what
you must be up to....
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
我感觉你被强大的法术诅咒了……
嗯……很清楚
你想做什么……

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You wish to get
rid of your curse....
By giving it to me!!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你想摆脱
你的诅咒……
通过把它转移给我！！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Just because I'm a cursed spirit, you adventurers think you can just dump your curses on me?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
就因为我是一个被诅咒的灵魂，你们这些冒险者就以为可以把你们的诅咒随便丢给我吗？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I refuse to let
you remain here.....
Leave now, or I will
remove you by force....
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
我拒绝让你
留在这里……
现在离开，否则我将
强行将你移除……

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
....And...
....Whatever you do...
....Do NOT touch my books...
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
……还有……
……无论你做什么……
……绝对不要碰我的书……

scripts.text: Touch the first book.
scripts.translation: 触摸第一本书。

scripts.text: Touch the second book.
scripts.translation: 触摸第二本书。

scripts.text: Touch the third book.
scripts.translation: 触摸第三本书。

scripts.text: Okay, I am leaving.
scripts.translation: 好的，我这就离开。

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...!...
How dare you touch my books
when I specifically said
'Don't touch my books!'
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
…！…
我明确说了
‘不要碰我的书！’
你竟敢碰我的书

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
....!...Grrrrr!
I shall tear you apart...!
Be bound by an eternal curse...!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
….！…咕噜噜！
我要把你撕碎……！
被永恒的诅咒束缚吧……！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...!...
You dare touch my books?!
Right after I said not
to touch them...?!
Foolish mortal!
...BEGONE!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
…！…
你竟敢碰我的书？！
就在我说过不要碰之后……？！
愚蠢的凡人！
……滚开！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Muhahahaha....
Stubborn mortal~!
Fine! I will give you
a fighting chance and let
you cast a spell.
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
穆哈哈哈哈……
顽固的凡人~！
好吧！我会给你一个
战斗的机会，让你
施展咒语。

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
But Blessings won't
work with the curse
that you have...
And the spell to lift
your curse has been
lost to the ages~!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
但是天使之赐福对
你所受的诅咒无效……
而解除你诅咒的咒语
早已失传于岁月之中~！

scripts.text: Clover
scripts.translation: 四叶草

scripts.text: Klaatu
scripts.translation: Klaatu

scripts.text: Klaytos
scripts.translation: Klaytos

scripts.text: Verit
scripts.translation: 毕莱特

scripts.text: Veritas
scripts.translation: Veritas

scripts.text: Verata
scripts.translation: Verata

scripts.text: Necktie
scripts.translation: 领带

scripts.text: Necklace
scripts.translation: 项链

scripts.text: Nero
scripts.translation: Nero

scripts.text: ^FFFFFFNictu!!!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FFFFFFNictu!!!^000000

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You... You broke the curse!
How did you know that spell?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你……你解除了诅咒！
你怎么知道那个咒语的？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I suppose you expect for me to
melt in agony about now, don't
you? Well... Sorry to disappoint
you, mortal, but I can never die!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
我想你现在指望我
在痛苦中融化，对吧？
好吧……抱歉让你失望了，
凡人，但我永远不会死！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Umhaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.....!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
…！你施放了正确的咒语？！
…！…
但是……你仍然被诅咒着……
Umhaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.....！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
What's...
this feeling?
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
这是……
什么感觉？

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
No...!
NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!

[Ashe Bruce]
Why did your spell have to work?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
为什么你的咒语非要生效？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You...
cast the correct spell?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你……
施放了正确的咒语？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Hoho~
But you're still cursed...
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
呵呵~
但你仍然被诅咒着……

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You... You broke the curse!
Who taught you that spell?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你……你解除了诅咒！
谁教给你那个咒语的？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I suppose you expect for me to
melt in agony about now, don't
you? Well... Sorry to disappoint
you, mortal, but I can never die!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
我想你现在指望我
在痛苦中融化，对吧？
好吧……抱歉让你失望了，
凡人，但我永远不会死！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
So long as I'm...
still...
cursed.
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
只要我还……
仍然……
被诅咒着。

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
NOOOOOOOOOO!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
不————！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Umhaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.....!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
…！你施放了正确的咒语？！
…！…
但是……你仍然被诅咒着……
Umhaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.....！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Mwahahahaaaa.....!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
…！你施放了正确的咒语？！
…！…
但是……你仍然被诅咒着……
Mwahahahaaaa.....！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Muhahahahahaha!
That's not the right spell!
Now, death awaits you!
You're eternally bound
to the curse...!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
穆哈哈哈哈哈哈！
那不是正确的咒语！
现在，死亡在等待着你！
你将永远被
诅咒束缚……！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...
.....
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
…
…..

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Well then.
Try not to trip on
your feet in your
rush to leave.
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
那么。
急着离开时
小心别绊倒。
